connector.name: Tersign Evidence
connector.registryDescription: Counter-signed evidence records for agent commerce: receipts, verification, dispute envelopes.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package tersign. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tersignhq account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TERSIGN_SELLER_KEY
env.description: 0x-prefixed private key the seller signs receipts with

env.name: TERSIGN_LEDGER_URL
env.description: Hosted ledger base URL for counter-signing (optional; SDK works standalone)

env.name: TERSIGN_LEDGER_API_KEY
env.description: Ledger seller API key (required only if counter-signing)

env.name: TERSIGN_LEDGER_SELLER_ID
env.description: Ledger seller id (required only if counter-signing)
